hook: ChatGPT gave my introverted friend and my extroverted friend the exact same advice for their job interviews. 🙃
caption:
ChatGPT gave my introverted friend and my extroverted friend the exact same advice for their job interviews. 🙃

One of them processes thoughts internally. Needs time to formulate. Gets drained by small talk but goes deep on ideas.

The other one thinks out loud. Builds energy in rooms. Stories come naturally.

The AI told them both: "Be enthusiastic. Make eye contact. Ask engaging questions."

Cool. Extremely helpful. Very tailored.

Here's the thing — generic advice isn't wrong. It's just useless when you're a specific person trying to solve a specific problem in a way that actually fits how your brain works.

My introverted friend needed: how to buy herself 3 seconds to think without looking checked out. How to redirect small talk into substance. How to show warmth without performing extroversion.

My extroverted friend needed: how to not talk over the interviewer. How to edit before speaking. How to make space for silence without filling it.

Same question. Two completely different useful answers.

That's what a BootFile does. It tells the AI which person is asking — before you even type the question.

No more generic. Just yours.
